## 🤝 Support & Ecosystem Guidelines

To ensure the scalability of **HYPER-FLOW** and maintain world-class Developer Experience (DX), please
use our official support channels:

---

### 💬 Community & Architectural Discussions

For usage questions, roadmap discussions, and technical brainstorming:

- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/glastor-core/hyper-flow/discussions):** Ideal for open
  technical dialogue.

### 🐛 Issue Triage & Bug Reports

For reproducible defects or formal capability requests:

- **[Open a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/glastor-core/hyper-flow/issues):** Please provide
  environment details, minimal reproduction scripts, and logs.

### 🛡️ Private Security Disclosure

Do not report critical vulnerabilities in public tickets:

1. Consult our **[Security Policy](https://github.com/glastor-core/hyper-flow/security/policy)**.
2. Submit a confidential report via
   **[Security Advisories](https://github.com/glastor-core/hyper-flow/security/advisories)** or email
   [glastor.info@gmail.com](mailto:glastor.info@gmail.com).
